recipes.summary: Creamy stovetop oats with pumpkin, cinnamon and crunchy walnuts. Tastes like dessert for pennies.
recipes.title: Pumpkin Pie Oatmeal

steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C) and cook the rice according to the package directions.
Whisk the soy sauce, honey, rice vinegar, ginger, garlic and sesame oil in a small bowl.
Put the salmon on a lined sheet pan, spoon over half the sauce and bake for 12 minutes until it flakes easily.
Flake the salmon into large pieces with a fork.
Divide the rice among four bowls and top with the salmon, cucumber, carrot and green onions.
Drizzle over the remaining sauce and sprinkle with the sesame seeds.
recipes.summary: Soy-honey glazed baked salmon over rice with cool cucumber and carrot.
recipes.title: Sesame Salmon Rice Bowls

steps: Cook the rice according to the package directions.
Press the tofu between towels for 10 minutes, then crumble it into small pieces and toss with the chipotle, chili powder, cumin and half the salt.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook the tofu 10 minutes, stirring now and then, until browned and crisp at the edges.
Warm the black beans in a small pot over medium heat for 5 minutes with a pinch of salt.
Stir the corn, red onion, lime juice, cilantro and remaining salt together for the salsa.
Divide the rice, beans and tofu among four bowls and top with the corn salsa and sliced avocado.
recipes.summary: Crispy spiced tofu over rice and black beans with a fresh lime-corn salsa.
recipes.title: Chipotle Tofu & Rice Bowls with Corn Salsa

steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
Toss the potatoes, chickpeas, onion, garlic, olive oil, juice of 1 lemon, oregano, paprika and salt on a large sheet pan and spread in a single layer.
Roast for 30 minutes, stirring once, until the potatoes are golden and tender.
Add the cherry tomatoes and olives and roast 10 minutes more, until the tomatoes burst.
Stir in the spinach so it wilts in the heat of the pan, then squeeze over the juice of the second lemon and serve.
recipes.summary: Roasted potatoes, chickpeas and tomatoes with lemon, garlic and olives, all on one pan.
recipes.title: Lemon-Oregano Potato & Chickpea Tray Bake

steps: Heat the oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium heat and cook the onion 6 minutes until soft, adding the garlic for the last minute.
Stir in the lentils, tomatoes, water, cumin, paprika and salt, then simmer, covered, for 25 minutes until the lentils are tender.
Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C) and stir the spinach into the stew until wilted.
Make eight small wells in the stew with a spoon and crack an egg into each one.
Bake for 8 to 10 minutes until the whites are set but the yolks are still soft.
Scatter the feta and parsley on top and serve straight from the pan.
recipes.summary: Hearty tomato lentil stew with eggs baked right in and a salty feta finish.
recipes.title: Baked Eggs in Spiced Lentil Stew

steps: Cook the pasta in salted water according to the package directions, saving 1 cup of the cooking water before draining.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook the mushrooms 8 minutes without stirring too often, until deeply browned.
Add the garlic, oregano and red pepper flakes and cook 1 minute, then add the white beans and cook 3 minutes, mashing a few against the pan.
Stir in the spinach and a splash of the pasta water until wilted.
Toss in the drained pasta, lemon juice, salt and pepper, adding more pasta water to loosen the sauce as needed.
recipes.summary: Browned mushrooms, creamy white beans and wilted spinach tossed with lemony pasta.
recipes.title: Garlicky Mushroom & White Bean Pasta

ingredients: 1 ½ lb chicken breast, thinly sliced
steps: Toss the chicken with the oil, oregano, paprika, garlic powder and salt.
Heat a large skillet over high heat and sear the chicken 6 to 8 minutes, stirring occasionally, until browned and cooked through.
Stir the yogurt, grated cucumber, juice of the lemon and garlic together for the sauce.
Warm the pitas in a dry skillet or the microwave for 20 seconds.
Fill the pitas with the chicken, tomatoes, red onion and a generous spoonful of sauce.
recipes.summary: Seared lemon-oregano chicken in warm pita with cool yogurt-cucumber sauce.
recipes.title: 20-Minute Greek Chicken Gyro Pitas

steps: Cook the orzo in salted water for 9 minutes, drain and rinse under cold water until cool.
Whisk the olive oil, juice of the lemons, oregano and salt together in a large bowl.
Add the orzo, chickpeas, cucumber, tomatoes, red onion and olives and toss well.
Fold in the feta and parsley.
Divide among four containers and refrigerate; it keeps 4 days, so stir before eating.
recipes.summary: A lemony orzo, chickpea and feta salad that tastes even better the next day.
recipes.title: Greek Orzo Pasta Salad Lunch Boxes

steps: Mash or blend the white beans with the tahini, juice of the lemons, garlic, olive oil, cumin and salt until creamy, adding a splash of water if it is stiff.
Lay the tortillas flat and spread each with a thick layer of the white bean hummus.
Top with the carrots, cucumber, spinach and red onion.
Roll up tightly, tucking in the sides, and slice in half to serve.
recipes.summary: Creamy white bean hummus rolled up with crunchy veggies, ready in ten minutes.
recipes.title: No-Cook White Bean Hummus Wraps

steps: Whisk the eggs with the salt and pepper.
Melt the butter in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat, scramble the eggs 2 to 3 minutes until just set, stir in the spinach until wilted, and move to a plate.
Wipe out the skillet, lay in one tortilla, and cover half with a quarter of the cheese and a quarter of the eggs.
Fold the tortilla over and cook 2 minutes per side over medium heat until golden and the cheese melts; repeat with the rest.
Cut into wedges and serve with salsa for dipping.
recipes.summary: Scrambled eggs, spinach and melty cheddar in a crisp tortilla, made in one skillet.
recipes.title: Cheesy Egg & Spinach Breakfast Quesadillas

steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
Stir the rice, broth, garlic, onion, juice of 1 lemon and half the salt together in a 9x13 baking dish.
Rub the chicken with the oil, oregano, paprika and remaining salt and nestle it on top of the rice.
Cover tightly with foil and bake 30 minutes.
Uncover, scatter the broccoli around the chicken, and bake 15 minutes more until the rice is tender and the chicken is browned.
Squeeze the second lemon over the pan before serving.
recipes.summary: Juicy chicken thighs baked over lemony rice with tender broccoli, no extra pots.
recipes.title: One-Pan Lemon Herb Chicken, Rice & Broccoli

steps: Simmer the lentils with the water and bay leaves in a covered pot over medium-low heat for 22 minutes until tender but not mushy; drain and discard the bay leaves.
Cook the onion in 1 tablespoon of the oil over medium heat for 6 minutes, then add the garlic and cumin for 1 minute.
Stir the onion mixture into the warm lentils with the salt, pepper, the juice of the lemons and 1 tablespoon of oil.
Fold in the cucumber, tomatoes, parsley and mint, then divide among 4 bowls and top with the feta.
Fry the eggs in the remaining oil over medium-high heat for 3 minutes until the whites are crisp and the yolks still runny, and set one on each bowl.
recipes.summary: Herby lemon lentils with cucumber, tomato and salty feta, topped with a crispy fried egg.
recipes.title: Warm Lentil & Feta Bowls with Fried Eggs

ingredients: 1 (10 oz) box frozen spinach, thawed and squeezed dry
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
Cook the mushrooms and onion in the oil in a 10-inch oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat for 8 minutes until the liquid cooks off, adding the garlic for the last minute.
Whisk the eggs with the ricotta, half the mozzarella, the parmesan, nutmeg, salt and pepper, then stir in the spinach.
Pour the egg mixture over the vegetables, scatter on the remaining mozzarella and cook over medium heat for 2 minutes until the edges set.
Bake 18 to 20 minutes until puffed and set in the center, rest 5 minutes, then slice and serve with the toast.
recipes.summary: A tall, creamy baked frittata packed with protein, served with toast.
recipes.title: Spinach, Ricotta & Mushroom Oven Frittata

steps: Soak or boil the rice noodles following the package directions, usually 5 minutes in boiling water, then rinse under cold water and drain well.
Whisk the peanut butter with the juice of the limes, sesame oil, ginger, garlic, sugar, hot sauce, salt and warm water until smooth and pourable.
Toss the noodles with the sauce, cabbage and carrots until evenly coated.
Divide among bowls and top with the cucumber, green onions, cilantro and chopped peanuts.
recipes.summary: Chewy rice noodles tossed in a zingy peanut-lime sauce with crunchy cabbage and carrots.
recipes.title: Lime-Peanut Rice Noodle Bowls

ingredients: 2 (15 oz) cans black beans, drained and rinsed
steps: Toss the chicken with the chili powder, cumin, paprika, garlic powder, 1 teaspoon of the salt, the juice of 1 lime and 1 tablespoon of oil, and let it sit 10 minutes.
Cook the chicken in a large skillet over medium-high heat for 6 to 7 minutes per side until browned and cooked through to 165°F (74°C), then rest 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, mix the beans, corn, red onion, cilantro, the juice of the remaining limes, 2 tablespoons of oil and the remaining salt.
Fold in the avocado just before serving, then slice the chicken and serve it over the salad.
recipes.summary: Juicy spiced chicken thighs with a bright, filling corn and bean salad.
recipes.title: Chili-Lime Chicken Thighs with Corn & Black Bean Salad

ingredients: 1 ½ lb potatoes, cut into ¾-inch cubes
steps: Cook the rice according to the package directions.
Cook the onion in the oil over medium heat for 8 minutes until golden, then add the garlic, ginger and jalapeño for 1 minute.
Stir in the cumin, coriander, turmeric, cayenne and half the garam masala for 30 seconds, then add the tomatoes and cook 5 minutes until thick.
Add the potatoes, water and salt, cover and simmer over medium-low heat for 15 minutes until the potatoes are tender.
Stir in the peas and remaining garam masala, simmer 3 minutes, and finish with the cilantro. Serve over the rice.
recipes.summary: Tender potatoes and sweet peas in a spiced tomato gravy, served over basmati rice.
recipes.title: Aloo Matar (Potato & Pea Curry)

steps: Boil the spaghetti in well-salted water for 9 minutes, adding the peas for the last minute, and save 1 cup of the pasta water before draining.
Meanwhile, cook the bacon in a large skillet over medium heat for 6 minutes until crisp, then add the garlic for 30 seconds and turn off the heat.
Whisk the eggs with the parmesan, pepper and salt.
Toss the hot drained spaghetti and peas with the bacon, then off the heat stir in the egg mixture with splashes of pasta water until glossy and creamy. Serve right away.
recipes.summary: Silky egg-and-cheese sauce, crisp bacon and peas, ready in 20 minutes.
recipes.title: Spaghetti Carbonara

steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
Mix the beef with the onion, bell pepper, parsley, tomato paste, cumin, paprika, coriander, cinnamon, salt and pepper until well combined.
Cut each pita open along one edge to make a pocket and stuff with a quarter of the filling, pressing it out flat to the edges.
Brush both sides of the pitas with the oil, set on a sheet pan and bake 18 to 20 minutes, flipping once, until the beef is cooked through and the bread is crisp.
Cut in halves and serve with the cucumber.
recipes.summary: Crispy baked pita pockets stuffed with juicy, herby spiced beef, an Egyptian street food favorite.
recipes.title: Hawawshi (Egyptian Spiced Beef-Stuffed Pita)

steps: Bring the oats, water and salt to a boil in a saucepan, then reduce to medium-low and cook 5 minutes, stirring, until thick and creamy.
Stir in the spinach, cheddar, garlic powder and pepper and cook 1 minute until the spinach wilts and the cheese melts.
Fry the eggs in the oil in a nonstick skillet over medium heat for 3 minutes until the whites set and the yolks are runny.
Spoon the oats into bowls, top each with an egg and drizzle with the hot sauce.
recipes.summary: Creamy stovetop oats with sharp cheddar and wilted spinach, topped with a runny egg.
recipes.title: Savory Cheddar Oats with Fried Egg & Spinach

steps: Blend 2 of the bananas with the plant milk, cocoa powder, maple syrup, vanilla and salt until completely smooth.
Whisk in the chia seeds and pour the mixture into 4 jars.
Cover and chill at least 4 hours or overnight, stirring once after 30 minutes so the seeds do not clump.
Slice the remaining banana, and top each jar with banana and walnuts just before eating.
recipes.summary: Make-ahead chocolatey chia pudding with banana, ready to grab from the fridge.
recipes.title: Banana Cocoa Chia Pudding Jars

steps: Boil the pasta in salted water for 9 minutes, adding the peas for the last minute, then drain and rinse under cold water until cool.
Whisk the mayonnaise with the mustard, the juice and zest of the lemons, salt and pepper in a large bowl.
Add the pasta and peas, tuna, celery, red onion and parsley and toss until evenly coated.
Pack into 4 containers and refrigerate until ready to eat, up to 4 days.
recipes.summary: A creamy, bright tuna pasta salad with peas and celery that keeps well for the week.
recipes.title: Lemony Tuna Pasta Salad Lunch Boxes

steps: Boil the egg noodles in salted water for 7 minutes until tender, then drain.
Brown the beef in a large deep skillet over medium-high heat for 6 minutes, breaking it up, then remove it with a slotted spoon and leave 1 tablespoon of fat in the pan.
Cook the onion and mushrooms in the same pan for 8 minutes until the liquid cooks off, adding the garlic for the last minute.
Stir in the flour, tomato paste and paprika for 1 minute, then pour in the broth, Worcestershire and mustard and simmer 5 minutes until thickened.
Return the beef to the pan, turn off the heat, stir in the sour cream, salt and pepper, then toss with the noodles and sprinkle with the parsley.
recipes.summary: Creamy mushroom and beef sauce over egg noodles, a comfort dinner for pennies.
recipes.title: Ground Beef Stroganoff

steps: Simmer the lentils in plenty of water for 20 minutes until tender, then drain. Cook the pasta in salted water for 2 minutes less than the package says and drain.
Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
Cook the onion in the oil over medium heat for 6 minutes until soft, add the garlic for 1 minute, then stir in the marinara, water, oregano and salt and bring to a simmer.
Stir the lentils, pasta and spinach into the sauce, then spread half in a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Dot the ricotta over the top, cover with the remaining pasta, and sprinkle with the mozzarella and parmesan.
Bake 20 minutes until bubbling and golden at the edges, then rest 5 minutes before serving.
recipes.summary: Hearty lentils and creamy ricotta baked into saucy pasta under a golden mozzarella top.
recipes.title: Cheesy Lentil & Ricotta Pasta Bake

steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Lay the tortillas on two baking sheets, brush lightly with half the oil, and bake 8 minutes, flipping once, until crisp and golden.
Warm the beans in a saucepan over medium heat with the cumin, chili powder, garlic powder, salt and water, mashing about half with a fork, for 8 minutes until thick.
Spread the beans over the tostadas, sprinkle with the cheese, and return to the oven for 3 minutes until melted.
Fry the eggs in the remaining oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat, covered, for 3 minutes until the whites are set.
Top each tostada with an egg, the tomato, a spoonful of salsa, a squeeze of lime juice and the cilantro.
recipes.summary: Crisp corn tostadas piled with smashed spiced black beans, melty cheese and a runny egg.
recipes.title: Black Bean Tostadas with Fried Eggs

ingredients: 2 lb sweet potatoes, peeled and cubed
steps: Cook the rice according to the package directions.
Cook the onion in the oil in a large pot over medium heat for 6 minutes until soft, then add the garlic and ginger for 1 minute.
Stir in the garam masala, turmeric and cumin for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the sweet potatoes, tomatoes, coconut milk, chickpeas, water and salt, bring to a simmer, cover, and cook 18 minutes until the sweet potato is tender.
Stir in the spinach until wilted, about 2 minutes, then finish with lime juice and serve over the rice.
recipes.summary: Tender sweet potato and chickpeas in a creamy, gently spiced coconut tomato sauce.
recipes.title: Coconut Sweet Potato & Chickpea Curry

ingredients: 1 ½ lb potatoes, cut into 1-inch chunks
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Toss the potatoes with 1 tbsp of the oil, ½ tsp of the salt and the pepper on a large sheet pan and roast 15 minutes.
Mix the garlic, mustard, oregano, paprika, 1 tbsp of the oil and 1 tsp salt, then rub it all over the pork.
Toss the green beans with the remaining oil, push the potatoes aside, and arrange the beans and the pork on the pan.
Roast 20 to 25 minutes until the pork reaches 145°F (63°C) in the thickest part.
Rest the pork 5 minutes, slice it, and squeeze the lemon over everything before serving.
recipes.summary: A juicy mustard-garlic pork tenderloin roasted on one sheet pan with crisp potatoes and green beans.
recipes.title: Garlic-Herb Pork Tenderloin with Potatoes & Green Beans

ingredients: 2 lb boneless chicken thighs, cut into chunks
steps: Stir the chicken with half the yogurt, half the salt and the turmeric, and let it marinate while you start the sauce.
Cook the rice according to the package directions.
Cook the onions in the oil in a large pan over medium heat for 12 minutes until deep golden, adding the garlic and ginger for the last minute.
Stir in the garam masala, coriander, cayenne and tomato paste for 1 minute, then add the chicken, almonds, water and remaining salt.
Simmer, covered, over medium-low heat for 20 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Take the pan off the heat, stir in the remaining yogurt, and serve over the rice with the cilantro.
recipes.summary: Tender chicken simmered in a mild, creamy yogurt and almond sauce with warm spices.
recipes.title: Chicken Korma

steps: Mix the beef with the grated onion, parsley, baharat, cinnamon and 1 tsp of the salt, then roll into about 24 walnut-sized meatballs.
Brown the meatballs in the oil in a wide pan over medium-high heat for about 6 minutes, turning, then move them to a plate.
Cook the diced onion in the same pan for 5 minutes, add the garlic for 1 minute, then stir in the tomato sauce, diced tomatoes, allspice, water and remaining salt.
Return the meatballs to the sauce, cover, and simmer over low heat for 25 minutes until cooked through and the sauce is thick.
Meanwhile, cook the rice according to the package directions.
Toast the almonds in a dry skillet for 3 minutes, then scatter them over the meatballs and serve with the rice.
recipes.summary: Spiced beef meatballs simmered in a cinnamon-scented tomato sauce, served over rice.
recipes.title: Daoud Basha (Lebanese Meatballs in Tomato Sauce)

steps: Cook the bacon in a large skillet over medium heat for 6 minutes until crisp, then move it to a plate and pour off all but 1 tbsp of the fat.
Scramble the eggs in the skillet over medium-low heat for 2 minutes until just set, then break them up and move them to the plate.
Add the oil and rice to the skillet over medium-high heat and fry, pressing and stirring, for 5 minutes until hot and lightly crisp.
Stir in the peas, soy sauce and pepper for 2 minutes.
Fold the bacon and eggs back in, and top with the green onions.
recipes.summary: Day-old rice fried with crisp bacon, peas and soft scrambled eggs for a cheap, filling morning plate.
recipes.title: Breakfast Fried Rice with Eggs & Bacon

steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment.
Mash the bananas well in a large bowl, then stir in the peanut butter, honey and vanilla until smooth.
Stir in the oats, baking powder, cinnamon and salt, then fold in the raisins and chocolate chips.
Scoop 12 mounds onto the sheet and flatten each slightly with a spoon.
Bake 12 to 14 minutes until golden at the edges, cool 10 minutes on the pan, and keep in a covered container in the fridge.
recipes.summary: Soft, lightly sweet oat cookies you can bake on Sunday and grab all week.
recipes.title: Peanut Butter Banana Oat Breakfast Cookies

steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Toss the sweet potatoes with 1 tbsp of the oil and ½ tsp of the salt on a large sheet pan and roast 10 minutes.
Whisk the mustard, honey, garlic, paprika, pepper, 1 tbsp of the oil and 1 tsp salt, then toss half of it with the chicken.
Add the chicken and the broccoli (tossed with the remaining oil) to the pan and roast 15 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and the vegetables are browned.
Meanwhile, simmer the quinoa in the water, covered, for 15 minutes until the water is absorbed, then fluff.
Divide the quinoa, chicken and vegetables among 4 containers and drizzle with the remaining honey-mustard sauce; reheat 90 seconds in the microwave.
recipes.summary: Roasted honey-mustard chicken, sweet potatoes and broccoli over quinoa, packed to reheat all week.
recipes.title: Honey-Mustard Chicken & Sweet Potato Meal-Prep Bowls

steps: Brown the sausage in the oil in a large deep skillet over medium-high heat for 5 minutes, then move it to a plate.
Cook the onion, bell pepper and celery in the drippings over medium heat for 6 minutes until soft, adding the garlic for the last minute.
Stir in the paprika, oregano, garlic powder and cayenne for 30 seconds, then add the tomatoes, rice, water and salt.
Return the sausage to the pan, bring to a boil, cover, and cook over low heat for 18 minutes until the rice is tender.
Let it stand 5 minutes covered, fluff with a fork, and top with the green onions.
recipes.summary: Smoky sausage, peppers and rice cooked in one pan with a kick of Cajun-style spice.
recipes.title: Cajun Sausage & Rice Skillet

steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
Cook the onion and pepper in the oil over medium heat for 5 minutes. Add the garlic, crumbled tofu and taco seasoning and cook 5 more minutes until the tofu is lightly browned.
Stir in the black beans and half of the enchilada sauce and cook 2 minutes.
Spread a spoonful of enchilada sauce in a baking dish. Layer half the tortillas, half the filling and a third of the cheese, then repeat with the remaining tortillas and filling.
Top with the remaining sauce and cheese and bake 20 minutes until bubbling and golden.
Rest 5 minutes, then scatter with cilantro and cut into squares.
recipes.summary: Layers of seasoned tofu, beans and melted cheddar between tortillas, baked until bubbly.
recipes.title: Cheesy Black Bean & Tofu Burrito Bake

steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Brush the eggplant rounds with 2 tablespoons of the oil, spread on two sheet pans and roast 20 minutes, flipping once, until golden.
Meanwhile simmer the lentils in the water for 20 minutes until tender, then drain.
Cook the onion in the remaining oil for 5 minutes, add the garlic for 1 minute, then add the tomatoes, oregano, salt and pepper and simmer 10 minutes. Stir in the lentils.
Lower the oven to 375°F (190°C). Spread a little sauce in a baking dish and layer eggplant, lentil sauce and mozzarella, finishing with sauce.
Sprinkle with parmesan and bake 20 minutes until bubbling, then rest 5 minutes before serving.
recipes.summary: Roasted eggplant layered with garlicky tomato lentils and two cheeses, a meatless parmesan with serious staying power.
recipes.title: Eggplant & Lentil Parmesan Bake

ingredients: 1 lb potatoes, cut into ¾-inch cubes
steps: Cook the onion in the oil over medium heat for 6 minutes until soft. Add the garlic, paprika and cumin and stir for 30 seconds.
Add the potatoes, tomatoes, chickpeas, water and salt and bring to a boil.
Simmer, partly covered, for 20 minutes until the potatoes are tender and the broth has thickened.
Mash a few potatoes against the pot to thicken the stew, then stir in the spinach until wilted, about 2 minutes.
Finish with the juice of the lemon.
recipes.summary: A hearty one-pot stew of potatoes, chickpeas and spinach in a smoked paprika tomato broth.
recipes.title: Smoky Spanish-Style Chickpea & Potato Stew

steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
Toss the potatoes with 2 tablespoons of the oil, half the salt and the pepper on a sheet pan and roast 20 minutes.
Push the potatoes to one side. Add the asparagus tossed with 1 tablespoon of the oil, and the salmon rubbed with the garlic, remaining oil, remaining salt and the zest and juice of 1 lemon.
Roast 12 minutes until the salmon flakes easily and the asparagus is tender.
Sprinkle with dill and serve with wedges from the second lemon.
recipes.summary: Crisp roasted potatoes, tender asparagus and flaky salmon, all on one pan.
recipes.title: Sheet-Pan Lemon-Dill Salmon with Potatoes & Asparagus

ingredients: 1 ½ lb chicken breast, cut into bite-size pieces
steps: Cook the rice according to the package.
Brown the chicken in 1 tablespoon of the oil over high heat for 5 minutes, then set aside.
Add the remaining oil and cook the onion and peppers for 5 minutes until just tender. Add the garlic, ginger and jalapeño for 1 minute.
Stir in the spices for 30 seconds, then add the tomatoes and salt and simmer 5 minutes.
Return the chicken and cook 6 minutes until cooked through and the sauce clings to the pieces.
Top with cilantro and serve over the rice.
recipes.summary: Stir-fried chicken with peppers and onions in a tangy, lightly spiced tomato sauce.
recipes.title: Chicken Jalfrezi

steps: Soak or boil the rice noodles according to the package, drain and rinse.
Whisk the soy sauce, honey, vinegar and sesame oil.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over high heat. Cook the garlic and ginger 30 seconds, then add the shrimp and cook 2 minutes per side.
Add the bok choy and cook 2 minutes until the stems are crisp-tender.
Add the noodles and sauce and toss 1 minute until coated. Top with green onions.
recipes.summary: Garlicky shrimp and bok choy tossed with rice noodles in a sweet-salty ginger sauce.
recipes.title: Ginger Shrimp & Bok Choy Noodles

steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Toss the carrots and onion with 2 tablespoons of the oil, the cumin and half the salt and roast 25 minutes until caramelized.
Simmer the lentils in the water for 20 minutes until tender, then drain.
Whisk the yogurt, remaining oil, juice of the lemon, garlic and remaining salt into a dressing.
Divide the spinach, lentils and carrots among four containers and top with feta.
Pack the dressing separately and stir it in just before eating, cold or reheated.
recipes.summary: Cumin-roasted carrots, lentils and spinach with feta and a lemony yogurt dressing that holds up all week.
recipes.title: Lentil & Roasted Carrot Meal-Prep Bowls

steps: Spread the peanut butter over half of each tortilla and top with banana slices, cinnamon and a drizzle of honey.
Fold each tortilla in half.
Heat the oil in a skillet over medium heat and cook the quesadillas 2 minutes per side until golden and warm through.
Cut into wedges and serve warm.
recipes.summary: Warm, crisp tortillas filled with peanut butter, banana and cinnamon for a cheap, filling start.
recipes.title: Peanut Butter Banana Breakfast Quesadillas

ingredients: 1 ½ lb chicken thighs, cut into bite-size pieces
steps: Brown the chicken in the oil in a large deep skillet over medium-high heat for 6 minutes, then remove it.
Cook the mushrooms and onion in the same pan for 6 minutes, add the garlic for 1 minute.
Stir in the orzo, broth, salt and pepper and bring to a simmer. Cook uncovered 10 minutes, stirring often.
Return the chicken and cook 4 more minutes until the orzo is tender and the sauce is creamy.
Stir in the spinach and parmesan until wilted, then finish with the juice of the lemon.
recipes.summary: One-pot orzo cooked in broth with browned chicken thighs, mushrooms, spinach and parmesan.
recipes.title: Creamy Chicken & Mushroom Orzo

steps: Cook the onion and bell pepper in the oil in a large pot over medium heat for 5 minutes until softened. Add the garlic and cook 1 minute.
Stir in the chili powder, cumin, paprika and garlic powder and cook 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the tomato sauce, diced tomatoes, water, salt and all three beans, and bring to a boil.
Stir in the macaroni, cover and simmer over medium-low heat for 12 minutes, stirring often, until the pasta is tender and the sauce has thickened.
Take the pot off the heat, stir in two thirds of the cheddar until melted, and scatter the rest on top before serving.
recipes.summary: Macaroni, three kinds of beans and plenty of cheddar in one smoky, saucy pot.
recipes.title: Three-Bean Chili Mac

ingredients: 28 oz firm tofu, pressed and cubed
steps: Cook the rice according to the package directions.
Toss the tofu cubes with the cornstarch until lightly coated.
Heat 2 tablespoons of the oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Fry the tofu for 8 to 10 minutes, turning, until golden and crisp on most sides, then move it to a plate.
Add the remaining oil and the bell pepper and cook 3 minutes. Add the garlic, ginger, white parts of the green onions and crushed red pepper and cook 1 minute.
Stir together the soy sauce, rice vinegar, sugar, sesame oil and water, pour it into the skillet and simmer 2 minutes until slightly thickened.
Return the tofu to the pan with the peanuts and toss to coat. Serve over the rice, topped with the green onion tops.
recipes.summary: Crispy tofu and peppers in a sweet, tangy, lightly spicy sauce with crunchy peanuts.
recipes.title: Kung Pao Tofu & Peanut Rice Bowls

ingredients: 1 head cauliflower, cut into small florets
1 (15 oz) can chickpeas, drained and patted dry
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Toss the cauliflower and chickpeas with the oil, chili powder, cumin, paprika, garlic powder and ¾ teaspoon of the salt on a large sheet pan.
Roast for 25 minutes, stirring once, until the cauliflower is browned at the edges and the chickpeas are crisp.
Mash the avocados with the juice of 1 lime, the garlic, the water and the remaining salt until smooth and creamy.
Toss the cabbage with the juice of the second lime and the cilantro.
Warm the tortillas in a dry skillet over medium heat, about 30 seconds a side, then fill with the roasted vegetables, cabbage and avocado cream.
recipes.summary: Crispy spiced cauliflower and chickpeas in corn tortillas with a cool avocado-lime cream.
recipes.title: Chili-Roasted Cauliflower & Chickpea Tacos

ingredients: 1 ½ lb potatoes, cut into chunks
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Toss the potatoes on a large sheet pan with the oil, the juice of 1 lemon, 1 teaspoon of the oregano and ½ teaspoon of the salt. Roast 15 minutes.
Mix the turkey, egg, feta, two thirds of the garlic, the parsley, the zest of the second lemon, the remaining oregano, the remaining salt and the pepper gently until just combined.
Shape the mixture into 16 meatballs. Push the potatoes to the sides of the pan, add the meatballs and roast 20 to 22 minutes, until the meatballs are cooked through and the potatoes are golden.
Stir the yogurt, cucumber, remaining garlic and a squeeze of lemon juice together to make the sauce.
Serve the meatballs and potatoes with the sauce spooned over.
recipes.summary: Juicy feta-studded turkey meatballs roasted alongside lemony potatoes, with a cool garlicky yogurt sauce.
recipes.title: Greek Turkey Meatballs with Lemon Potatoes & Cucumber Yogurt

steps: If the shrimp are frozen, put them in a bowl of cold water for 5 minutes, then drain and pat dry.
Toss the coleslaw mix with the juice of 1 lime, the cilantro, jalapeño and ¼ teaspoon of the salt.
Toss the shrimp with the chili powder, cumin, garlic powder, paprika and remaining salt.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over high heat and cook the shrimp for 2 to 3 minutes a side until pink and just cooked through. Squeeze over the juice of the second lime.
Warm the tortillas in a dry skillet or directly over a flame for 20 seconds a side, then fill with shrimp, slaw, avocado and sour cream.
recipes.summary: Quick-seared spiced shrimp in warm corn tortillas with a bright lime slaw and cool sour cream.
recipes.title: Chili-Lime Shrimp Tacos with Crunchy Slaw

ingredients: 20 oz frozen spinach, thawed and squeezed dry
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Cook the onion in 2 tablespoons of the oil over medium heat for 6 minutes until soft, and let it cool a few minutes.
Mix the onion with the spinach, the juice of 2 lemons, the sumac, pomegranate molasses, pine nuts, salt and pepper. The filling should taste bright and tangy.
Divide the dough into 12 pieces and roll each into a 4-inch circle on a lightly floured counter.
Spoon a heaping tablespoon of filling into the center of each circle, then fold up three sides and pinch the seams firmly to form a triangle.
Place the pies on two lined baking sheets, brush with the remaining oil and bake 18 to 20 minutes until golden. Serve warm or at room temperature.
recipes.summary: Little pinched triangles of soft dough around a lemony, sumac-spiced spinach filling.
recipes.title: Fatayer bi Sabanekh (Lebanese Spinach Pies)

steps: Simmer the lentils in plenty of water for 20 minutes until tender but not mushy, then drain and cool.
Cook the rice according to the package directions and spread it on a plate to cool for 10 minutes.
Whisk the oil, the juice of 2 lemons, curry powder, cumin and salt in a large bowl.
Add the lentils, rice, carrots, apple, raisins, red onion and parsley and toss well.
Divide into four jars or containers, top each with almonds and refrigerate up to 5 days. Eat cold or at room temperature.
recipes.summary: A sweet-and-savory lentil, rice, apple and raisin salad that gets better after a night in the fridge.
recipes.title: Curried Lentil & Rice Lunch Jars

ingredients: 2 (15 oz) cans black beans, drained and rinsed
steps: Whisk the juice of 3 limes with the olive oil, cumin and salt in a large bowl.
Add the black beans, corn, mango, red onion, jalapeño and cilantro and toss gently.
Divide the romaine among four bowls and spoon the salad on top.
Fold the diced avocado in at the last minute, or add it on top so it stays green, and serve right away.
recipes.summary: A fresh no-cook bowl of black beans, sweet mango, corn and creamy avocado with a lime-cumin dressing.
recipes.title: Mango Black Bean Salad Bowls

steps: Combine the rice, milk, sugar, cinnamon and salt in a medium saucepan and bring to a gentle simmer over medium heat, stirring.
Reduce the heat to low and cook 25 minutes, stirring every few minutes, until the rice is tender and the pudding is creamy.
Stir in the vanilla and raisins and cook 2 minutes more; it will thicken as it cools.
Spoon into four bowls and top with sliced banana. Leftovers keep in the fridge and reheat with a splash of milk.
recipes.summary: Creamy stovetop rice pudding with cinnamon, vanilla and plump raisins, topped with banana.
recipes.title: Cinnamon Raisin Rice Pudding Breakfast Bowls

ingredients: 2 lb pork shoulder, cut into chunks
steps: Pat the pork dry and season with the salt. Brown it in the oil in a large heavy pot over medium-high heat in two batches, about 6 minutes each, then set aside.
Cook the onion in the same pot for 5 minutes, then add the garlic, jalapeño, cumin and oregano and cook 1 minute.
Return the pork to the pot with the salsa verde and water, bring to a boil, then cover and simmer on low for 1 hour.
Add the potatoes and simmer, partly covered, 25 to 30 minutes more until the pork and potatoes are tender and the sauce has thickened.
Meanwhile cook the rice according to the package directions.
Stir the lime juice and cilantro into the stew and serve over the rice.
recipes.summary: Fork-tender pork and potatoes simmered in a tangy salsa verde sauce, served over rice.
recipes.title: Easy Pork Chile Verde

steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (204°C) and line two sheet pans with parchment or foil.

Mix the turkey, breadcrumbs, eggs, parmesan, grated onion, half the garlic, half the Italian seasoning, 1 teaspoon of the salt and the pepper until just combined, then roll into about 40 golf-ball-sized meatballs.
Bake the meatballs 18 minutes until browned and cooked through.

Meanwhile, warm the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat, cook the remaining garlic 1 minute, then add the crushed tomatoes, sugar, remaining Italian seasoning and remaining salt and simmer 15 minutes.
Add the baked meatballs to the sauce and simmer gently 10 minutes while you boil the spaghetti according to the package directions.
Serve half the meatballs over the spaghetti; cool the other half completely and freeze in a container for up to 3 months, then reheat in a pot with a splash of water.
recipes.summary: A double batch of tender baked meatballs simmered in garlicky tomato sauce. Eat half tonight over spaghetti, freeze the rest.
recipes.title: Freezer Turkey Meatballs in Marinara

ingredients: 1 ½ lb potatoes, cut into chunks
steps: Spread the potatoes, carrots and onion in the bottom of the slow cooker and scatter the garlic over them.
Season the beef with the salt and pepper and lay it on top of the vegetables.
Whisk the tomato paste, broth, vinegar and Italian seasoning together, pour it over the beef and tuck in the bay leaves.
Cover and cook on low for 8 hours until the beef is very tender.
Stir the cornstarch into the water, mix it into the stew with the frozen peas, and cook uncovered on high for 15 minutes until the gravy thickens.
Remove the bay leaves and serve hot.
recipes.summary: Fork-tender beef, potatoes and carrots in a rich, savory gravy that cooks itself all day while you're out.
recipes.title: Slow-Cooker Beef Stew

photo.credit: Kitchen Life of a Navy Wife · CC BY 2.0

steps: Heat the oil in a large deep pot over medium-high heat and cook the mushrooms for 5 minutes until browned.
Stir in the garlic for 30 seconds, then add the pasta, broth, milk, Italian seasoning, salt and pepper.
Bring to a boil, then reduce to a steady simmer and cook 12 to 14 minutes, stirring often, until the pasta is tender and the liquid has turned into a thick sauce.
Turn the heat to low and stir in the cream cheese and parmesan until smooth and creamy.
Fold in the spinach for 1 minute until wilted, then finish with a squeeze of lemon juice and serve right away.
recipes.summary: Pasta cooks right in a garlicky mushroom broth and finishes with cream cheese, parmesan and spinach. One pot, about 25 minutes.
recipes.title: Creamy Garlic One-Pot Pasta

steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Pat the chicken dry and rub it with 1 tablespoon of the oil, the paprika, thyme, 1 teaspoon of the salt and the pepper.
Heat the remaining oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat and sear the chicken skin-side down for 5 minutes until deep golden, then set it aside.
In the same skillet, cook the onion and carrots for 4 minutes, add the garlic for 1 minute, then stir in the rice and the remaining salt.
Pour in the broth and bring to a simmer, then nestle the chicken skin-side up on top of the rice.
Cover tightly with foil and bake 35 minutes, then uncover and bake 10 minutes more until the rice is tender and the chicken reaches 175°F (80°C).
Squeeze the lemon over the pan, sprinkle with parsley and let it rest 5 minutes before serving.
recipes.summary: Crisp-skinned chicken thighs bake on a bed of garlicky rice and carrots that soaks up all the juices. One pan, no fuss.
recipes.title: One-Pan Garlic & Herb Chicken Thighs with Rice

steps: Trim the zucchini and hollow each one with a corer or small spoon, leaving walls about ¼ inch thick; chop a handful of the scooped flesh and save the rest for another meal.
Mix the beef with the rice, half the onion, half the garlic, seven spice, 1 teaspoon of the salt, the parsley and the chopped zucchini flesh.
Loosely fill each zucchini about three-quarters full, since the rice will swell as it cooks.
Heat the oil in a wide pot over medium heat and cook the remaining onion for 5 minutes, then add the remaining garlic and tomato paste for 1 minute.
Stir in the crushed tomatoes, water, the remaining salt and the juice of the lemon, then lay the stuffed zucchini in the sauce.
Cover and simmer over low heat for 40 minutes, until the rice and zucchini are tender, then spoon the sauce over the top to serve.
recipes.summary: Zucchini hollowed and packed with spiced beef and rice, then simmered in a lemony tomato sauce.
recipes.title: Mahshi Koussa (Lebanese Stuffed Zucchini)

ingredients: 2 lb potatoes, peeled and cut into chunks
steps: Cover the potatoes with cold salted water in a pot, bring to a boil and cook 15 to 20 minutes until very tender.
Meanwhile, heat 2 tablespoons of the oil in a large pot over medium-high heat and cook the mushrooms for 8 minutes until deeply browned.
Add the onion and carrots and cook 5 minutes, then stir in the garlic, tomato paste and thyme for 1 minute.
Add the lentils, bay leaf, broth, 1 teaspoon of the salt and the pepper, then simmer partly covered for 25 minutes until the lentils are tender and the stew is thick.
Stir the peas into the stew for the last 3 minutes and remove the bay leaf.
Drain the potatoes and mash them with the almond milk, the remaining oil and the remaining salt until smooth.
Spoon the mash into bowls and ladle the stew over the top.
recipes.summary: A thick, savory lentil and mushroom stew ladled over creamy dairy-free mashed potatoes.
recipes.title: Garlicky Mushroom & Lentil Stew over Mashed Potatoes

ingredients: 1 ½ lb boneless chicken thighs, cut into bite-size pieces
steps: Cook the rice according to the package directions.
Heat the oil in a large deep skillet over medium-high heat and cook the onion for 5 minutes until soft and golden.
Stir in the garlic and ginger for 1 minute, then add the garam masala, cumin, turmeric, cayenne and salt and stir for 30 seconds.
Add the chicken and cook for 5 minutes, stirring often, until it is no longer pink on the outside.
Add the spinach a handful at a time with the water, cover, and simmer on medium-low for 8 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and the spinach is wilted.
Take the pan off the heat, stir in the yogurt and the juice of the lemon, and serve over the rice.
recipes.summary: Tender chicken simmered in a creamy, garlicky spinach gravy with warm spices. Ready in 30 minutes over rice.
recipes.title: Chicken Saag

steps: Cover the chicken with water in a saucepan, add the salt, bring to a boil, then cover and simmer on low for 15 minutes until cooked through.
Meanwhile, cook the rice noodles in boiling water for 4 minutes, drain, and rinse under cold water so they do not stick.
Whisk the soy sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil, peanut butter, honey, ginger, the juice of the lime and the water until smooth.
Shred the cooled chicken with two forks.
Divide the dressing between 4 large jars or containers, then layer the noodles, chicken, cabbage, carrots, green onions, peanuts and cilantro on top.
Seal and refrigerate for up to 4 days, then shake or toss everything together before eating.
recipes.summary: Crunchy cabbage, carrots and rice noodles with shredded chicken and a peanut-sesame dressing that holds up all week.
recipes.title: Sesame Chicken & Cabbage Noodle Jars

steps: Pat the beef dry, season it with the salt and pepper, and place it in the slow cooker with the onions, garlic, thyme and bay leaves.
Whisk the flour into the broth and Worcestershire sauce until smooth, then pour it over the beef and onions.
Cover and cook on low for 8 hours, until the beef shreds easily with a fork.
Remove the bay leaves and stir in the butter. Cook the egg noodles in salted boiling water for 7 minutes, then drain.
Heat the broiler. Divide the noodles and beef among oven-safe bowls, top each with Swiss cheese and broil 2 to 3 minutes until bubbly and golden.
recipes.summary: Tender beef and sweet melting onions in a savory gravy over buttery noodles, topped with bubbly Swiss.
recipes.title: Slow-Cooker French Onion Beef & Egg Noodles

steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Cut a deep pocket into the side of each chicken breast, then season the outside with half the salt, the pepper, paprika and garlic powder.
Stuff each pocket with the mozzarella and tomato slices and set the chicken in an oiled baking dish.
Stir the mayonnaise and mustard together and spread it over the tops of the chicken.
Bake 28 to 32 minutes until the topping is golden and the chicken reaches 165°F (74°C), then rest 5 minutes.
Toss the cucumbers, cherry tomatoes, red onion, vinegar, olive oil and remaining salt in a bowl for the salad.
Toast the bread and serve it with the chicken and salad.
recipes.summary: Juicy baked chicken pockets filled with melty mozzarella and tomato under a tangy mustard-mayo crust, served with a crunchy cucumber salad and toast.
recipes.title: Cheesy Tomato-Stuffed Chicken Breasts with Cucumber Salad

ingredients: 1 ½ lb chicken breast, cut into bite-size pieces
steps: Cook the rice according to the package, steaming the broccoli florets on top for the last 5 minutes.
Toss the chicken with the egg, salt and pepper, then coat each piece in the ½ cup cornstarch.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and fry the chicken in two batches for 4 to 5 minutes per batch until golden and cooked through; move to a plate.
Wipe the skillet, then add the zest of 1 orange, the juice of both oranges, soy sauce, honey, vinegar, garlic, ginger and cayenne and simmer over medium heat for 3 minutes.
Stir the 1 tbsp cornstarch into the water, whisk it into the sauce and simmer 1 minute until glossy and thick.
Add the chicken back to the skillet and toss for 1 minute to coat, then serve over the broccoli rice.
recipes.summary: A copycat of mall-court orange chicken: crisp pan-fried chicken in a sticky fresh-orange glaze, for a fraction of the takeout price.
recipes.title: Crispy Orange Chicken with Broccoli Rice

ingredients: 2 lb potatoes, cut into thick wedges
1 ½ lb white fish fillets, cut into strips
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C) and put two sheet pans in to heat.
Toss the potato wedges with 3 tbsp of the oil, 1 tsp of the salt and the paprika, spread them on one hot pan and roast 20 minutes.
Season the fish with the remaining salt and the pepper, then dip each strip in the flour, the beaten eggs and finally the breadcrumbs, pressing the crumbs on.
Brush the second hot pan with the remaining oil, add the fish and bake 12 to 14 minutes, flipping the potatoes halfway through, until the fish is golden and flakes easily.
Stir the mayonnaise, pickles, mustard and the juice of ½ lemon together for the tartar sauce.
Simmer the peas in a little water for 3 minutes, drain and mash lightly with a squeeze of lemon, then serve everything with lemon wedges.
recipes.summary: A copycat of the chip-shop classic, fish and chips: crunchy breaded fish and thick potato wedges baked in the oven, with a quick tartar sauce and buttery peas.
recipes.title: Oven-Baked Fish & Chips with Quick Tartar Sauce

steps: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat and cook the onions for 6 minutes until soft, then stir in the garlic, jalapeños, cumin, oregano and chili powder for 1 minute.
Add the chicken thighs, half of the beans and the broth, then bring to a boil, cover and simmer on medium-low for 20 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Lift the chicken onto a plate and shred it with two forks, while you mash the pot's beans with a spoon to thicken the broth.
Return the chicken to the pot with the remaining beans, the corn, salt and pepper, and simmer uncovered for 10 minutes.
Stir in the juice of both limes and the cilantro, then taste and add more salt if needed.
Cool completely, then freeze half in flat zip bags or containers for up to 3 months and reheat gently on the stove.
recipes.summary: A mild, lime-bright chili packed with tender chicken and creamy white beans. Make one pot, freeze half for another night.
recipes.title: Big-Batch White Bean Chicken Chili

steps: Put the carrots, celery, onion and garlic in the slow cooker and lay the chicken breasts on top.
Whisk the flour into the broth with the thyme, salt and pepper, pour it over the chicken, and tuck in the bay leaves.
Cover and cook on low for 6 hours, or on high for 3 hours, until the chicken shreds easily.
Remove the bay leaves, shred the chicken with two forks in the pot, and stir in the peas.
Cut each biscuit into quarters, drop them over the top, then cover and cook on high for 30 minutes until puffed and cooked through.
Spoon into bowls and serve while hot.
recipes.summary: Fall-apart chicken and vegetables in a creamy herb broth, topped with fluffy biscuit dumplings. Set it in the morning and dinner is waiting.
recipes.title: Slow-Cooker Chicken & Dumplings

steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C) and boil the spaghetti in salted water for 2 minutes less than the package says, then drain.
Brown the beef with the onion in a large skillet over medium-high heat for 7 minutes, breaking it up, then stir in the garlic for 1 minute.
Stir in the marinara, Italian seasoning, salt and pepper and simmer on medium-low for 5 minutes.
Melt the cream cheese into the alfredo sauce in a small pot over low heat, stirring for 3 minutes until smooth.
Toss the spaghetti with the creamy sauce and spread it in a 9x13-inch baking dish, then spoon the meat sauce over the top and sprinkle with mozzarella.
Bake uncovered for 20 minutes until bubbling and golden at the edges, then rest 5 minutes before serving.
recipes.summary: Meaty marinara and creamy alfredo layered over spaghetti, topped with melty mozzarella. A cheesy family favorite.
recipes.title: Creamy Beef Spaghetti Bake

ingredients: 1 ½ lb chicken breast, sliced into thin strips
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C) and line a 9x13-inch baking pan with parchment paper.
Blend the cottage cheese, eggs, garlic powder, onion powder, Italian seasoning and half the salt until smooth, then pour into the pan and spread evenly.
Bake for 40 minutes until set and lightly golden, then let it cool 10 minutes and cut into 8 rectangles.
Toss the chicken with the oil, paprika, pepper and remaining salt, then cook in a hot skillet over medium-high heat for 6 minutes until browned and cooked through.
Stir the yogurt with the juice of the lemon for a quick sauce.
Fill the flatbread pieces with the chicken, cucumber, tomato, arugula and red onion, then drizzle with the yogurt sauce and fold like sandwiches.
recipes.summary: A protein-packed flatbread baked from blended cottage cheese and eggs, folded around spiced chicken and crunchy veg.
recipes.title: Cottage Cheese Flatbread Chicken Sandwiches
